//: Functions run next to the database, not next to the CDN.
The Supabase project lives in ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Every page in this app
is a server component that makes several round trips — auth, then two or
three queries. Running functions in iad1 (Washington DC) put roughly
12,000 km between the function and the database on every single one of
those trips, which is why navigation felt slow.
bom1 is Vercel's Mumbai region, the same city as the database. Static
assets still serve from the global edge network; only the functions move.
